values.note: MWCD's own reservation site or the call center, 1-855-822-6764 (Mon-Fri 9-6, Sat-Sun 9-5); book at least 48 hours ahead (a Friday night by Wednesday). Changes and cancellations through the park office, 330-343-6780. Visa, MasterCard or Discover only. After Labor Day and before Memorial Day some MWCD parks switch to self-registration at the gate.

values.note: Active-duty military 25% off daily camping (subject to availability, free park admission); veterans 10%; seniors 60+ 10%; former POWs and 100% disabled veterans 50% off daily and 30-day camping. Only one discount, and only for the senior or veteran staying on the site.

note: Muskingum Watershed Conservancy District (regional authority) park on Atwood Lake near Mineral City, with camp areas A-H and 1-4 and a limited number of seasonal sites. --Claude

flags: UNVERIFIED (captcha): https://reserve.mwcd.org/atwood/camping answers an AWS WAF 'Human Verification' image puzzle ('Choose all the curtains') to plain HTTP and to the browser driver; not solved. So the transient RV site count, per-site Area H lakefront tags, the cheapest RV night, what the $87/$99 group is, and whether any area takes winter campers are unread. These need a human pass of the engine.

FEES (manual provenance, not overwritten): stored $27-99 from AWH's saved July 2027 calendar. mwcd.org adds a non-refundable '$8.00 per site non-refundable reservation fee' (charged once per reservation - suggest fees.reservation_fee 8) and lists no rates of its own ('For rates on camping, cabins, and pavilions: reserve.mwcd.org'). The cheapest night per the stored note is the $27 30-amp electric site Sun-Thu; a $87/$99 'premium group' is not described anywhere on mwcd.org.

Park entry fee: 'Memorial Day Weekend-Labor Day Daily admission: $5 for single-occupant vehicles; $10 for vehicles with two or more passengers.' Campers don't pay it: 2026 Rules B.3 'Passes issued with each camping permit must be displayed on the rearview mirror to allow free access at the entrance gate.' Not stored as an entrance fee.

Site count: mwcd.org says '600+ campsites' on the park page and 'more than 500 campsites, RV rental, and seasonal camping' on the camping page; stored count 530 (derived from note) left alone. MWCD seasonal permits run April 1 - October 31 with a lottery and 'a limit to the number of seasonal campsites that are permitted each year'; the seasonal share at Atwood is not published.

Season left as stored (year_round false, derived): MWCD's 'Primary Season' is April 1 - October 31 and 'WINTER SEASON ... November 1 through March 31' is a storage-permit term, but whether Atwood sells winter nights could not be read from the engine.

Waterfront (stored lakefront): Area H is described in the inclusion evidence and old note as 142 lakefront full-hookup sites; the Area H map (area_h_sitesii.pdf) shows the area on the lake shore, but per-site tags could not be read. Re-check per site when the engine is read.

Pin 40.5447,-81.2700 sits on the entrance road by the park office at the north edge of the camp areas; the camp loops spread 0.3-1.2 km south and east along the shore. Suggest ~40.5432,-81.2660 (the middle of the camp areas, ~380 m ESE) if a central pin is wanted.
